title: Galah
blurb: The galah, less commonly known as the pink and grey cockatoo, galah cockatoo, or rose-breasted cockatoo, is an Australian species of cockatoo and the only member of the genus Eolophus.
facts: The species is endemic to mainland Australia.
It was introduced to Tasmania, where it is now widespread, in the mid-20th century and much more recently to New Zealand.
